tasks.label: 2 - Deploy WAR to Tomcat
args: $tomcat = Read-Host 'Enter Tomcat folder path'; if (!(Test-Path "$tomcat\webapps")) { throw 'Tomcat webapps folder not found' }; Copy-Item 'target\personal-expense-tracker.war' "$tomcat\webapps\personal-expense-tracker.war" -Force; Write-Host 'WAR copied. Stop and restart Tomcat if it was already running.'

tasks.label: 3 - Start Tomcat (current terminal)
args: $tomcat = Read-Host 'Enter Tomcat folder path'; Set-Location "$tomcat\bin"; .\catalina.bat run
